study: prospective matched-learner split-mode development benchmark, not original M5 or fresh-v5 promotion

finite.spatial_groups: world.spatial_groups mapped to sampled cell_id; GroupKFold

process.knockout: remove complete declared process information closure on identical folds
process.classify: frozen v5 classify_process_state + identical closure abstention

finite.consensus: both learners same sharp state; else unresolved; unavailable on either -> unavailable

oracle.opening_order: finite decisions and SHA256 receipt persisted BEFORE ODO reference is computed
oracle.interpretation: distribution-information approximation conditional on model/world, not causal process truth

primary_estimands: pair full-system joint authorization by split over all 24 cases
pair stable-sharp coverage by split over all 24x6 process cells
positive-state recovery among oracle ODO contributory/required states using full fixed denominator
false favorable-positive attribution among ODO replaceable/unresolved/unavailable states
confusion with unavailable and unresolved retained in denominator
secondary_estimands: paired case-wise random minus spatial sharp-coverage difference
generating-process membership metadata, never substituted for ODO target
jointly authorized conditional sharp rate explicitly reported as descriptive

analysis_policy.missing_or_unavailable: retain all declared worlds/seeds/cells; never silently drop
analysis_policy.compare_splits: paired within exactly same simulated world/seed, do not infer causal source of real-data failure
analysis_policy.failures: report independently of desired effect; no threshold change or seed reruns
analysis_policy.software: Python 3.12; numpy 2.3.5, pandas 2.2.3, scipy 1.17.0, scikit-learn 1.8.0, frozen source at branch execution receipt

activation.first: design and tests from burned seeds only
activation.third: one-shot prospective execution on never-opened seeds
